Roughly, follow this procedure:

== Create A Link ==
Find a page you want to link from, edit it, and put the desired page name in link brackets e.g. 
<pre>[[My New Page Title]]</pre>
Think about the title as it will appear on the page itself, not as it should be in a link. If you want to change the link text, you can do so by separating it from the title with a pipe (|) character, e.g.
<pre>[[My New Page Title|Link to my new page]]</pre>

Now when you reload that page, you should see a red link to your new page. Click on it, and you will be editing your new page.

== Add Content ==
Put in whatever content you want.

<label type="info">Note</label> It's good to get into the habit of sprinkling double-square brackets around the first use of a new term, it encourages people to make new pages.
For example:
<pre>
The Alam regularly consult with their top magicky people, the [[Hakima]]...
</pre>
That way, even if you don't make the page about the Hakima yourself, someone will be encouraged to.

== Make It Navigable ==
When you're done, consider adding it to a [[Help:Categories|category]] (or categories), so that it'll play nicely with the rest of the site. If it's a new category, you might want to consider updating the [[Help:Editing Breadcrumbs|Breadcrumbs]] file. And you might conceivably want to add it to any of the [[Help:Editing Empire Navigation|menus]].

If, for example, it's an article relevant to a particular nation, it should be put in two categories - Nations, and the nation itself. e.g. add this text to the bottom of the document.
<pre>
[[Category:Nations]]
[[Category:Alam]]
</pre>
